services.value: Hampton-Clarke provides environmental laboratory services for “organic and inorganic analysis of various matrices,” including a range of analytical methods such as volatile and semivolatile organics, pesticides, PCBs, petroleum hydrocarbons, metals, mercury, and anions/cations. It also provides field services (sample collection and certified analyze-immediately parameters) and construction support including waste disposal, waste management, health and safety services, and field sampling.
